_comment: Single source of truth for card frontmatter. To add or change a key, edit THIS file and commit with op 'schema:'. scripts/card_frontmatter_lint.py reads it; nothing else defines card keys.

id.description: Card id, src-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN. NNN is a 3-digit sequence within that day, from 001.

date.description: The date the SOURCE asserts for itself. Use the ingest date only if the source has none.

origin.description: Which kind of source system this came from.

trust.description: How much to trust the claims. Contradictions resolve by higher trust first, then newer date.

topics.description: Non-empty list of wiki topics, [a, b].

raw.description: Relative path to the verbatim artifact. Omit when wiki-born, e.g. a live session.

parent.description: Card id of the parent source when ingesting a tree. Omit on the root.

source_id.description: Native id in the source system: Confluence page id, Jira key, Slack ts.

source_url.description: Canonical link back to the source.

source_version.description: Version captured, so a re-ingest can detect drift.

source_parent_id.description: Parent in the SOURCE system, recorded even when that parent was not ingested.
